{{Top}}
[[File:SenCamDroid-Ep1IG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A holocam in the [[Senate]]]]
{{Quote|Holocams are like bureaucrats. They're everywhere. Can't escape them, so you ignore them.|Iella Wessiri Antilles|<ref name="swu3">[[Union 3|''Union'' 3]]</ref>}}
A '''holocamera''', or simply '''holocam''', was a device that could record [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images and sound. Some holocams were fitted with small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and limited artificial intelligence. Holocams could be used in security applications and would come in all manner of all shapes and configurations.

[[Cam droid/Legends|Cam droids]] served as roving cameras for covering large events, and were used to record anything from [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] sessions to [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]].

The [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] was filmed by fast-moving cams that transmitted imagery of the podrace to handheld viewscreens carried by spectators. Furthermore, many [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] used holocam droids to record incidents involving their officers, including the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
